items.title: File the Berks County hotel room rental tax return
items.description: All hotel operators send the monthly remittance report to the Treasurer on or before the 25th for the prior month's room sales, even when no tax is due. Late filings more than 5 days past due cost $100 plus 1.5% monthly interest under the county's 2016 rules.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax; only the lodging tax was checked for Berks.

items.title: File the Bucks County hotel room rental tax return
items.description: The tax is 5% of the gross room rental. Establishments with fewer than 100 rooms, including short-term rentals, file quarterly: April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31. Establishments with 100 or more rooms file monthly, due at the end of the following month.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax; only the lodging tax was checked for Bucks.

items.title: File the Chester County hotel room rental tax return
items.description: The tax is 5% of the gross room charge (4.65% when breakfast is included). Hotels submit a monthly tax report by midnight on the 25th after the close of each calendar month.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax; only the lodging tax was checked for Chester.

items.title: File the Cumberland County hotel room rental tax return
items.description: The tax is 5% since April 1, 2024. Online reports and payments are due by the 20th of the following month (mailed ones postmarked by then), and a report is required even with no bookings. Booking-platform hosts must still register and file; a 1.5% late fee is added each month unpaid.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax; only the lodging tax was checked for Cumberland.

items.title: File the Dauphin County hotel room rental tax return
items.description: The tax is 5% of revenue, due on the last day of the month after the period collected. Late remittances and reports cost $100 plus 9% annual interest, with no provision for waiver.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax; only the lodging tax was checked for Dauphin.

items.title: File the Delaware County hotel room rental tax return
items.description: The tax is 3% of each room rental. Operators file and pay on or before the 10th of the month after collection, with interest and penalties of 1.5% a month. Since February 1, 2026 hotel and short-term rental operators register and report online in the county's GovOS portal.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental
